subject: Security questionnaire options and evidence timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — security intake & questionnaire options

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet you and Tom. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Medicore priority: HIPAA compliance and a clear timeline for evidence to close procurement.
- You requested options for questionnaire format: SIG-Lite, CAIQ, or our custom short form (to limit asks to PHI/PII-related controls).
- You also wanted confirmation on Redwood’s SOC 2 posture and sample evidence we can provide quickly.

To move forward, would you prefer we:
1) Prefill a SIG-Lite and send it back for your review (fastest), or
2) Start with a custom 10–12 question PHI-focused form, or
3) Complete CAIQ (longer but sometimes required by security teams)?

Separate asks: please confirm whether Medicore will be sending PHI in production or only pseudonymized data during evaluation, and whether you need data residency in a US-only region. That will affect what evidence we prioritize.

Proposed timeline: we can return a prefilling for SIG-Lite within 3 business days once you confirm format and provide any existing questionnaire template. If you prefer CAIQ, expect ~10 business days.

I’ve attached the scope outline you mentioned and our short evidence checklist to speed things up (attachment: redwood_evidence_checklist.xlsx).

Next step: confirm preferred questionnaire format and whether there are any mandatory CAIQ sections you cannot waive.

Thanks,
Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@medicorehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@medicorehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — security intake & questionnaire options

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. For Medicore: 

- We are a HIPAA-covered entity and will need to confirm PHI handling before production. During POC we will only provide de-identified or pseudonymized data (for now).
- We require a SIG-Lite as the first step; procurement prefers a short prefilling to speed internal review. Full CAIQ may be requested later but we want to avoid that upfront.
- Data residency: US-only for now.
- SOC 2: we need Redwood’s latest SOC 2 Type II report and an inventory of subprocessors.

Clarifying questions from our security team to help the prefill: 
1) Do you have a documented retention policy for logs and request traces (we need retention windows for 12–24 months)?
2) How is customer data isolated in multi-tenant serving (tenant-level namespaces, encryption-in-transit and at-rest)?
3) Will Redwood sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) or do you have a standard addendum?

I attached our high-level scope map and a cropped data flow diagram for reference (attachments: Medicore_SIG-Scope.pdf, Medicore_DataMap.png). Can you provide the SOC 2 report and a prefilling of SIG-Lite with answers for the questions above? Ideally by 2 weeks out.

Appreciate it — Claire
Claire Simmons
Director of IT Security, Medicore Health
claire.simmons@medicorehealth.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — security intake & questionnaire options

Claire — thanks, that’s very helpful. A few clarifications and what we’ll deliver: 

Answers to your quick Qs: 
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security, availability) audit in Sep 2025; we can provide the latest report under NDA.
- Retention: default request/log retention is 18 months; we can configure shorter windows for customers on Dedicated/Private.
- Multi-tenant isolation: logical tenant namespaces + per-customer encryption keys (KMS-backed).
- BAA: Redwood does offer a standard BAA for HIPAA customers — I’ll loop Legal if Medicore wants a draft.

What we’ll send within 3 business days after you confirm SIG-Lite: 
- Prefilled SIG-Lite PDF with answers for the PHI-focused controls and the three items above.
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted as required) subject to an NDA.
- Subprocessor list and a short note on data residency controls.

Open items where we need Medicore input: 
- Confirm whether a signed BAA is required for the POC or only for production.
- Confirm any specific CAIQ sections you consider non-negotiable (if later requested).

If that timeline works, I’ll assign Marissa (Security Ops) to prepare the prefill and evidence bundle. Ben — looped for pricing/contract impact if BAA and SOC delivery are gating.

Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
